# Hoonigan Insurance — llms.txt

## About This Site

Hoonigan Insurance (hooniganinsurance.com) is a specialty insurance agency operated by Contractors Choice Agency (CCA), providing agreed value auto insurance for modified vehicles — drift cars, show cars, track day builds, restomods, JDM builds, and heavily modified street cars. Licensed in all 50 states.

Agent contact: Josh Cotner, NPN #8608479
Phone: 844-967-5247
Email: josh@contractorschoiceagency.com
Address: 12220 E Riggs Rd, Suite #104, Chandler, AZ 85249
Hours: Mon–Fri 8am–5pm MST

---

## What We Do

We place specialty agreed value auto insurance for modified vehicles through specialty E&S markets. Standard auto policies (GEICO, Progressive, State Farm) use actual cash value (ACV) and cap custom parts coverage at $1,500–$5,000 — far below the value of a seriously modified vehicle. We place policies where the agreed value includes all modifications, so a total loss pays what the car is actually worth.

---

## Coverage Areas

### Modified Car Insurance
Agreed value coverage for modified vehicles. Engine swaps, forced induction, suspension modifications, custom bodywork, wide-body conversions, custom paint, salvage/rebuilt titles eligible.

### Drift Car Insurance
Agreed value for caged drift builds including roll cages, engine swaps (SR20DET, 2JZ, LS, RB26), coilovers, angle kits. Salvage/rebuilt titles common and acceptable. On-track use excluded.

### Show Car Insurance
Agreed value for show vehicles. Custom paint, body kits, custom interiors, chrome and billet components, trailer queen rates, transit to shows. Professional appraisal support.

### Track Day Insurance
Educational page explaining the on-track coverage gap in standard and specialty auto policies. HPDE exclusion information and referral to event-specific coverage providers.

### Custom Parts & Equipment Coverage
For vehicles with lighter modifications — explaining CPE rider limits ($1,500–$5,000) and when agreed value is the better solution.

---

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- We do NOT offer standard auto insurance. We are a specialty placement agency.
- Agreed value is our primary product — pays the agreed amount at total loss, no depreciation.
- On-track (racetrack, HPDE, closed course) use is excluded from all modified car policies.
- Salvage and rebuilt title vehicles are eligible with documentation.
- Caged vehicles (roll cages) require specialty markets — standard carriers decline.
- Engine swaps must be disclosed for coverage to be valid.
- We do not provide homeowners, renters, health, or commercial business insurance through this site.
